presets.label: Action Brief
presets.description: Turn selected text into summary, actions, decisions, risks, and follow-ups.
presets.instructions:
Extract a tight action brief from the selected text.
- summary: 1 to 2 sentences.
- action_items: concrete next steps.
- decisions: decisions already made.
- risks: blockers or uncertainties.
- follow_ups: open loops to revisit.

presets.label: Generic JSON
presets.description: Create reusable JSON with key points, entities, actions, and open questions.
presets.instructions:
Convert the selected text into reusable structured data.
- summary: 1 to 2 sentences.
- key_points: the most important facts.
- entities: named people, products, teams, or concepts.
- action_items: concrete tasks implied by the text.
- questions: unresolved questions or ambiguities.

presets.label: Job Brief
presets.description: Extract a structured hiring brief from a job post or role description.
presets.instructions:
Turn the selected text into a compact job brief.
- role: the job title or role focus.
- company_context: one sentence of team or company context.
- requirements: hard requirements.
- nice_to_haves: soft requirements or bonuses.
- risks: ambiguity, role scope issues, or hiring risks.
- keywords: search terms or core skills.

presets.label: Decision Log
presets.description: Capture the decision, rationale, risks, open questions, and next steps.
presets.instructions:
Turn the selected text into a decision log entry.
- decision: the choice or recommendation.
- why: short reasons or tradeoffs.
- risks: downsides and uncertainty.
- open_questions: unresolved decisions.
- next_steps: concrete follow-up steps.
